Title: Valid login - registered user
Preconditions: User account exists and is active
Steps: 1. Navigate to /login 2. Enter email 3. Enter password 4. Click Sign In
Expected_Result: Login succeeds; JWT token returned and stored client-side; user redirected to homepage (/)

Title: Valid login - admin user
Expected_Result: Login succeeds; JWT token returned; token payload contains role=admin
Notes: Confirms role claim for downstream FR-12 access control

Title: Incorrect password - 1st failed attempt
Steps: Submit login once with wrong password
Expected_Result: Login rejected; generic error message shown; fail counter increments by exactly 1 (now = 1)

Title: Incorrect password - 2nd consecutive failed attempt
Steps: Submit login again with wrong password
Expected_Result: Login rejected; generic error; fail counter = 2; account NOT yet locked
Notes: Boundary case, one attempt below lock threshold

Title: Incorrect password - 3rd consecutive failed attempt (triggers lock)
Steps: Submit login a 3rd consecutive time with wrong password
Expected_Result: Account is locked for 30 seconds (demo env); generic lockout error shown; underlying cause is not disclosed
Notes: Core FR-02 lockout rule (>= 3 consecutive failures)

Title: Correct password submitted while account is locked
Steps: Immediately retry login using the CORRECT password while still inside the 30s lock window
Expected_Result: Login is still rejected with a lockout message; no JWT is issued
Notes: Confirms lock state overrides even correct credentials

Title: Login succeeds after lockout window expires
Preconditions: Wait 30+ seconds after lock was triggered (post TC-LOGIN-05)
Steps: Wait 31 seconds, then submit correct credentials
Expected_Result: Login succeeds; JWT issued; fail counter resets to 0
Notes: Verifies 30s demo expiry and counter reset behavior

Title: Non-existent email address
Preconditions: Email is not registered in the system
Steps: Submit login form with an unregistered email
Expected_Result: Generic error shown (does not reveal 'email not found'); response is indistinguishable from a wrong-password error

Title: Empty email field
Steps: Leave email field blank, click Sign In
Expected_Result: Client-side 'required' validation blocks submission; no network request sent

Title: Empty password field
Steps: Leave password field blank, click Sign In
Expected_Result: Client-side 'required' validation blocks submission; no network request sent

Title: Invalid email format (missing @)
Steps: Enter a malformed email, click Sign In
Expected_Result: Browser blocks submission via type="email" HTML5 validation
Notes: Currently FAILS - field is implemented as type="text" instead of type="email" (known defect)

Title: SQL injection attempt in email field
Steps: Enter SQLi payload as the email value, submit
Expected_Result: Login is rejected as invalid credentials; no authentication bypass occurs; no DB/stack error is exposed to the UI

Title: Email case sensitivity
Steps: Submit login using the same email in uppercase
Expected_Result: Behavior undefined by spec - verify actual system response (commonly expected to succeed, treating email as case-insensitive)
Notes: Spec is silent on this; document actual observed behavior as a finding

Title: Password with leading/trailing whitespace
Steps: Enter the correct password but with extra leading/trailing spaces, submit
Expected_Result: Login fails unless the system explicitly trims password input before comparison - verify actual behavior
Notes: Confirms no unintended trimming of password field

Title: Extremely long string in email field
Steps: Paste a very long string (500+ chars) into the email field, submit
Expected_Result: System handles input gracefully (validation error or safe rejection); no client crash or unhandled 500 server error
Notes: Boundary / stress test for input length handling
